# OpenZeppelin Contracts for Cairo

> Reusable Cairo smart contract components, interfaces, utilities and presets for Starknet.

Contract links target release `v4.0.1`. Check the linked manifests for independently versioned
packages. Testing links target published `openzeppelin_testing` version `6.11.0` at its release
commit. Use documentation matching the version you install.

## Start here

- [Documentation](https://docs.openzeppelin.com/contracts-cairo): guides and versioned API reference
- [Release manifest](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/Scarb.toml): toolchain, editions and dependency versions

## Package catalogs

- [openzeppelin_access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/access/README.md): Ownership and role-based permissions
- [openzeppelin_account](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/account/README.md): Starknet accounts and account extensions
- [openzeppelin_finance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/finance/README.md): Vesting
- [openzeppelin_governance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/governance/README.md): Governor, votes, timelock and multisig
- [openzeppelin_interfaces](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/interfaces/README.md): Shared ABI traits and dispatchers
- [openzeppelin_introspection](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/introspection/README.md): SRC5 interface introspection
- [openzeppelin_merkle_tree](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/merkle_tree/README.md): Merkle proof verification
- [openzeppelin_presets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/presets/README.md): Deployable contract presets
- [openzeppelin_security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/security/README.md): Initialization, pausing and reentrancy protection
- [openzeppelin_token](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/token/README.md): Token standards and extensions
- [openzeppelin_upgrades](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/upgrades/README.md): Contract class upgrades
- [openzeppelin_utils](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/utils/README.md): Cryptography, deployment and data structures
- [openzeppelin_macros](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/v4.0.1/packages/macros/README.md): Procedural macros; add as a separate dependency
- [openzeppelin_testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/5cf9010e653b8da506f1e9824cd74c441c4f8d87/packages/testing/README.md): Foundry helpers; add as a separate dev dependency

## Examples and API reference

- [Preset contracts](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/tree/v4.0.1/packages/presets/src): deployable component compositions
- [Test mocks](https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/tree/v4.0.1/packages/test_common/src/mocks): integration and extension examples
- [Contracts Wizard](https://wizard.openzeppelin.com/cairo): generate a contract from selected components
- [ERC20 API reference](https://docs.openzeppelin.com/contracts-cairo/4.x/api/erc20): token interfaces, components and extension APIs
- [Testing API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/5cf9010e653b8da506f1e9824cd74c441c4f8d87/packages/testing/docs/SUMMARY.md): generated reference for the testing package

## Contributor guidance

- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/AGENTS.md): current contributor setup, conventions and architecture

## Audits and security

The current audit index identifies the exact commit and scope of each report.

- [Audit index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/audits/README.md): report PDFs, release, commit, auditor and scope
- [Security policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/cairo-contracts/main/SECURITY.md): private vulnerability reporting
